about: Speed budget for the front page, read by speed.js. recorded is the build on 2026-11-14 after A3's lighter page (hand paint as short relative paths, the photos as grey AVIF; film bytes are fetched as they near the screen); limits are recorded + 10 %, timings at least + 25 ms (paint varies 72-96 ms between runs of the same build). Bytes are as served by the walk's plain server (no compression), after a walk down the whole page. Paint and blocking are the middle of three first-visit loads, before any scroll. Timings come from a headless browser without a graphics card. 2026-11-22 (Tom): image, film and total re-recorded for the sharper project media (films 1280/390 wide, stills 1920); the first screen's paint stayed at 80 ms. 2026-11-24 (Tom): css limit +1 KB (37696 -> 38720) for the privacy label by the live form's Send; /privacy's own styles load only there. Go-live re-records the budget for the new front. 2026-11-26 (W-3): the hand paint of the pieces written on the scroll is one file (/hands.svg) put in once the page has settled, so html fell from 740 KB to 110 KB and the page's data is no longer carried twice; the file counts as image bytes. html, image and total re-recorded; the first screen's paint is the same.

pitchStart.about: What the paint page's bucket waits for, read by tools/pitch/checks/startbytes.js: bytes fetched and ms until dataset.readyAt, on a fast line (ms is mostly the bucket's own filling, about 2.2 s, so it barely moves) and on a phone's line (1 MB/s, 100 ms, CPU x6, nothing cached: slowMs, where the bytes show). before = master 572e909 (every texture, the 8 paintings and the 22 stencil frames on the default loading manager); recorded = perf/start-load (only the start set; the workshop's and EDGE's paintings and the stencil frames load after the tip; the concrete's occlusion and roughness maps are 1024, its bump map stays 2048 because 1024 blurred it). limits = recorded + 10 % on bytes, room for the machine's noise on ms.
